Example SDTM LB-like data

example_sdtm_lb.Rd

Creates a small synthetic SDTM LB-like dataset for demos. Part of the bundled SDTM supplemental module.

Usage

example_sdtm_lb()

Value

A data.frame with one or more laboratory records per subject.

Examples

lb <- example_sdtm_lb()
head(lb)
#>   STUDYID DOMAIN     USUBJID LBSEQ LBTESTCD     LBTEST LBORRES LBORRESU
#> 1 STUDY01     LB STUDY01-001     1      HGB Hemoglobin    13.0     g/dL
#> 2 STUDY01     LB STUDY01-001     2      HGB Hemoglobin    13.4     g/dL
#> 3 STUDY01     LB STUDY01-002     1      HGB Hemoglobin    -1.0     g/dL
#> 4 STUDY01     LB STUDY01-002     2      HGB Hemoglobin    14.1     g/dL
#> 5 STUDY01     LB STUDY01-003     1      HGB Hemoglobin    15.0     g/dL
#>   LBSTRESN      LBDTC VISITNUM SITEID
#> 1     13.0 2024-01-01        1 SITE01
#> 2     13.4 2024-01-29        2 SITE01
#> 3     -1.0 2024-01-03        1 SITE01
#> 4     14.1 2024-01-31        2 SITE01
#> 5     15.0 2024-01-04        1 SITE02
